badge_title: Indonesian Capital Market Financial Research Assistant
hero_title: IDX Stock Research & Valuation Made Faster and Structured
hero_desc: Sectors Copilot automates fundamental analysis for the Indonesian stock market. Simply query in natural language to dissect company performance, benchmark industry ratios, and screen potential stocks accurately.
features_title: Practical Solutions for Capital Market Analysis
feature_1_desc: Query company financials, valuation trends, or recent performance summaries directly in Indonesian or English without manually digging through financial reports.
feature_1_example: Example: "How has BBCA's profit growth and leverage trended over the last 3 years?"
feature_2_desc: Compare multiple companies side-by-side against sector averages to evaluate relative attractiveness across PER, PBV, ROE, and dividend yields.
feature_2_example: Example: "Compare valuations among major banks: BBCA, BBRI, BMRI, and BBNI."
feature_3_desc: Screen stocks tailored to your custom criteria without configuring complex technical filters. The system delivers top matches aligned with your metrics.
feature_3_example: Example: "Find consumer goods stocks with high dividend yields and low debt."
workspace_title: Manage All Research in One Unified Dashboard
workspace_1_desc: Save watchlist candidates and private analytical records to your personal account for instant retrieval at any time.
workspace_2_desc: Track market sector movements and actively traded tickers to gain macro context before making investment decisions.
